subject: One-click copyable new-conversation handoff across development and product UX
canonical_classification: P0/MUST cross-line handoff invariant for FA3/CFA3 development and FA3/CFA3 product UX.
trigger: Explicit user request to continue in a new conversation, including Hungarian 'folytasd új beszélgetésben' and semantic equivalents.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: the complete handoff payload is contained in exactly one copyable surface/window.
AC-2: one copy action places the complete payload on the clipboard.
AC-3: the same behavior applies to a one-word or one-character payload.
AC-4: no payload fragment requires a second copy action, manual selection, or scrolling to become copyable.
AC-5: development workflow guidance and product conversation/session contracts both carry the same invariant.
